services.name: Free Tours
services.desc: Unfolding now through October, The Broad is reinstalling nearly two-thirds of its collection galleries, bringing more than 30 works out of the vault. Highlights include pairings of works by Cindy Sherman and John Baldessari, Urs Fischer and Jonas Wood, and Anselm Kiefer and Kara Walker, along with changes in the Takashi Murakami gallery and much more throughout the third floor. These changes mean new artworks to see each month, offering a chance to see more of The Broad's over 2,000-works collection and a preview of what's to come.
